style.backgroundSystem: every screen is built from the same material language: the cloth itself. backgrounds are stacks, pleated fans and rolled cylinders of the same embossed nonwoven sheet, laid on a seamless cool porcelain studio field #F6F7F4, with one secondary plane only - a pale stitch-shadow swatch panel #DCE1DC crossed by a single dashed running-stitch rule in #C22A54; design screens use flat swatch cards with pinked zig-zag sheared edges in #EFF1EC, never rounded-corner chips; only two planes per screen meeting at one clean edge; no marble, no tiled bathroom wall, no clinical or laboratory room, no frosted glass riser, no stone or plaster plinth, no wooden board, no rattan or straw, no linen weave, no coloured poster block or cut-paper step, no cyclorama colour wash, no sky, no gradient mesh, no leaf or botanical shadow cut-out, no water splash or droplet field, no warm ivory-oatmeal-moss-wheat wash, no aqua-mint-teal clinical wash, no chalk-cobalt-amber poster wash, no smoke-grey satin-silver-graphite wash, no violet-lilac backlit wash, no powder-blue marigold cloud set, no terracotta-peach-apricot sunlit set, no bone-paper mulberry ledger wash

style.iconSystem: every pictogram is drawn as a running stitch - the glyph outline is built from short 1.4pt dashes with visible thread gaps, as if sewn with thread, in #C22A54 on the porcelain field #F6F7F4 and in #F6F7F4 on the stitch-shadow panel #DCE1DC, maximum four per screen laid in one horizontal row on one shared baseline above their caption line; glyph interiors stay blank with no lettering; numbering is written as a small stitched cross mark followed by a tracked numeral, never as a circled digit; no rounded-square chips of radius 12, no filled chips, no badges, no capsules, no rings, no dotted circles, no diamond glyphs, no corner tabs, no marigold tab cards, no arch frames, no electron-microscope spheres, no bacteria, virus, microbe, cell or pathogen artwork, no flask, beaker, microscope, shield, hourglass or red-cross shape
style.lightingSystem: one soft 5600K cool-neutral source placed LOW BEHIND the set at camera-back-left so the light travels through the drawn nonwoven sheet and rims every folded edge from behind, paired with a broad porcelain bounce card at camera-front-right that keeps the front label readable; shadows are long, soft and always fall toward camera-front-right; the transmitted glow through the cloth is the signature of the set and appears in every screen either as a backlit sheet or as a lit folded crest; specular allowed only as a thin line along the die-cut aperture rim; never a warm 4800K amber wrap, never a 6500K aqua clinical cast, never a hard 5900K overhead flash, never an upper-left key, never an upper-right key, never a front-left daylight key, never rim-only low-key, never a shadowless flat beauty light

style.presentationRules: the pack is always the same rigid or semi-rigid rectangular draw pack standing square on its base, or laid flat on its back panel, with the top-face pull-out aperture open by exactly one drawn sheet whose crest stands upright and leans in one consistent camera-left direction; the printed front label zone stays a blank legible field in its reference position and is never re-lettered, re-scaled, recoloured or restyled; both side seams and the base fold stay intact and the pack is never re-sculpted into a tub, a pump bottle, a spray trigger, a sachet or a roll; any drawn or loose sheet is always a matte embossed spunlace nonwoven with a visible fine dot-and-dash surface relief, never a smooth paper towel, never a wood-pulp film and never looped terry; the cloth used as background architecture is the same sheet with the same relief; product scale is constant across the set and every unit and every folded stack keeps a visible soft contact shadow toward camera-front-right; any human present is shown only from behind or cropped above the jaw, never recognisable, and the sheet never touches a face, an eye area or an abrasion; no percentage, count, dimension, badge, slogan or mark is ever painted back onto the label
